criterion_1_silent_failure.evidence: reconciler.ts implements PENDING_RETRY status, throws explicit error on deduction failure, does not swallow errors

criterion_2_rollback_implementation.evidence: rollbackBudget.execute() called on deduction failure; actual cost preserved as economic fact in reconciliation record (never deleted)

criterion_3_idempotency.evidence: idempotencyKey implemented as `smace:deduct:{brief.canonicalWorkId}`, prevents double deduction; includes providerUsageReceiptId and runtimeJobId in metadata

criterion_4_canonical_work_validation.evidence: non-null assertion removed; runtime check validates brief.canonicalWorkId exists before any transaction, throws error if missing

criterion_5_eos_state_separation.evidence: .eos-state stores only engineering memory (ARCH reports, verification artifacts); operational evidence stored in canonical Evidence Registry via evidenceRegistryService.record()

criterion_6_tenant_isolation.evidence: workspaceId added to CreativeBrief; session.workspaceId validated against brief.workspaceId to prevent cross-tenant access
